items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: She took them away with me and brought them to New York

ctx.x: What did Happy play like? Drums?

Oh man, Happy was, Happy was a player. Happy played drums and, and, and, and solophones. He played on the boat with, with Faith and him. He played the Lyric Theater. They used to have a, Lyric Theater right on the corner of Burgundy and, and Aberdeen. Well, they used to bring acts in like, like reviews, colored reviews, you know, like Ethel Wallace. She, she's the one that took, uh, what's called them away from here, that, uh, had a guy around here by the name of Jackson. Willie Jackson. Oh yeah. She took them…
What if I asked the Monk, well who did he play with?
